description: This file implements bcrypt password hashing functions, including password hashing, comparison, and version/cost handling, with external dependencies on crypto and blowfish.

classes.name: hashed
classes.description: Struct representing a bcrypt hashed password, including hash, salt, cost, and version info.

methods.name: GenerateFromPassword
methods.description: Generates bcrypt hash from password with specified cost.

methods.name: CompareHashAndPassword
methods.description: Compares bcrypt hashed password with plaintext password.

methods.name: Cost
methods.description: Returns the cost used to create the hashed password.

methods.name: newFromPassword
methods.description: Creates a hashed struct from password and cost, generating salt and hash.

methods.name: newFromHash
methods.description: Parses a hashed password byte slice into a hashed struct.

methods.name: bcrypt
methods.description: Performs bcrypt hashing with specified password, cost, and salt.

methods.name: expensiveBlowfishSetup
methods.description: Sets up Blowfish cipher with key, salt, and cost.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Serializes hashed struct into bcrypt hash string.

methods.name: decodeVersion
methods.description: Decodes version info from bcrypt hash string.

methods.name: decodeCost
methods.description: Decodes cost info from bcrypt hash string.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns string representation of hashed struct.

methods.name: checkCost
methods.description: Validates if cost is within allowed range.
